stories.title: Mission accomplished - Hong Kong advance to ICC WCL Division 4 final after defeating Jersey by 100 runs
stories.subTitle: ICC World Cricket League Division 4
stories.summary: Mission accomplished. Hong Kong achieved their primary objective at the ICC World Cricket League Division 4 tournament by advancing to the final of the tournament and gaining promotion back to Division 3 and a chance to qualify for the 2011 World Cup. The

stories.title: Nadeem grabs six in ICC WCL warm-up
stories.subTitle: ICC World Cricket League Division 4
stories.summary: Hong Kong's spin ace Nadeem Ahmed grabbed six wickets as Hong Kong beat the Tanzania Academy XI by 53 runs in a warm-up match preceding the start of the ICC World Cricket League Division 4 tournament.

stories.title: Hong Kong advances
stories.subTitle: ACC Trophy Elite 2008
stories.summary: Hong Kong won their final group-match, in what was virtually a quarter-final against Singapore, by 93 runs to go through to the semi-finals of the ACC Trophy Elite, where they will face Afghanistan on Friday.
